title: Chargeback Evidence Bundle Composer
description: CHECKRUN definition assembling an agent-transaction dispute pack: mandate/receipt evidence (AP2 mandate chain, AP2 receipt), payment-protocol evidence (x402 payload, A2A x402 extension, batch settlement reconciliation), and session + delivery evidence (trace spans, delivery attestation). Produces a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted adjudication bundle prepared for a payment-network dispute/adjudication review. Verify-only.

evidence.description: Per-step attestation notes or sha256 evidence digests, keyed by evidence step_id

adjudication_bundle.description: definition, definition_digest, run_receipt (Merkle root over 8 step receipts), step_receipts, coverage_summary

mcp_tool_definition.name: compose_chargeback_evidence_bundle
mcp_tool_definition.description: Runs the agent-payment dispute CHECKRUN across mandate/receipt, payment-protocol, and session/delivery evidence groups and produces a hash-chained, Merkle-rooted adjudication bundle. Verify-only: does not initiate, contest, route, or settle a chargeback.

evidence.description: Per-step attestation notes or sha256 evidence digests
